about_the_game:
The “Aero - All Skins Unlocked” DLC blends aesthetic creativity with refined gameplay design. This premium expansion introduces a range of visually striking skins, each crafted to give your ball a unique identity while enhancing the game’s overall energy and feel.
Some skins are purely cosmetic, adding color and personality, while others include subtle gameplay benefits — improved control, smoother motion, or refined balance. These enhancements are designed to complement, not disrupt, the game’s balance, offering variety without unfair advantage.

This DLC celebrates individuality and mastery. Whether you aim to dominate the leaderboard or simply enjoy rolling in style, the Advanced Style Collection lets you do both. Every skin carries its own visual presence and gameplay touch, encouraging creativity and precision with every move.

Redefine your presence, play with flair, and overcome every obstacle — your way.
